title: Dreamcore Mall Afterhours
description: Shuttered shopping malls after closing, photographed with 90s direct consumer flash — half-lowered metal gates, dead kiosk signage, empty benches, stopped fountains — the familiar weekend cathedral rendered hollow.

zh-CN.description: 打烊后的购物中心:半落下的卷帘门、熄灭的店招、空长椅和停掉的喷泉,用直闪消费级相机记录熟悉空间被抽空后的怪异感。
